# Sonarr's hub around the writes whose lists another tab shows, and what a
# rescan that imports a file queues: a recording of its own, with the hub
# listened to (GOLDEN_SIGNALR=1), so that the long list next door did not
# have to be recorded again for them. Same format as ../golden/requests.txt;
# signalr.json holds what the hub sent after each step.
#
#   GOLDEN_SIGNALR=1 GOLDEN_REQUESTS=tests/fixtures/sonarr/golden-hub/requests.txt \
#       GOLDEN_OUT=tests/fixtures/sonarr/golden-hub make golden

# a file dropped into a series folder and found by a rescan: the import
# asks for the downloads to be refreshed, as a grab does. First in the
# list, before the scheduler's own refresh of each minute.
mock - POST /mock/fs/write?path=/tv/The%20Pitt/Season%2001/The.Pitt.S01E03.1080p.WEB.H264-Fixture.mkv&clip=episode
command-rescan-1 POST /api/v3/command bodies/command-rescan-1.json
sleep 12
command-after-rescan GET /api/v3/command

# the same for a file imported from a drop folder, as Unpackerr or a
# script would ask for it
mock - POST /mock/fs/write?path=/downloads/drop/The.Pitt.S01E04.1080p.WEB.H264-Fixture/The.Pitt.S01E04.1080p.WEB.H264-Fixture.mkv&clip=episode
command-downloaded-scan POST /api/v3/command bodies/command-downloaded-scan.json
sleep 12
command-after-downloaded-scan GET /api/v3/command

# tags, and the auto tagging rules that raise the same event
tag-create POST /api/v3/tag bodies/tag-create.json
sleep 2
tag-update PUT /api/v3/tag/{id:tag-create} bodies/tag-update.json
sleep 2
tag-delete DELETE /api/v3/tag/{id:tag-create}
sleep 2
autotagging-create POST /api/v3/autotagging bodies/autotagging-create.json
sleep 2
autotagging-delete DELETE /api/v3/autotagging/{id:autotagging-create}
sleep 2

# root folders, then remote path mappings: the hub, and the health checks
# tied to their saves, which end in a "health" message some five seconds
# later
rootfolder-create POST /api/v3/rootfolder bodies/rootfolder-create.json
sleep 9
rootfolder-delete DELETE /api/v3/rootfolder/{id:rootfolder-create}
sleep 9
remotepathmapping-create POST /api/v3/remotepathmapping bodies/remotepathmapping-create.json
sleep 9
remotepathmapping-delete DELETE /api/v3/remotepathmapping/{id:remotepathmapping-create}
sleep 9

# quality definitions: one, all of them, the reset
qualitydefinition-1-before GET /api/v3/qualitydefinition/1
qualitydefinition-put-1 PUT /api/v3/qualitydefinition/1 bodies/qualitydefinition-put-1.json
sleep 2
qualitydefinition-update PUT /api/v3/qualitydefinition/update bodies/qualitydefinition-update.json
sleep 2
command-reset-quality-definitions POST /api/v3/command bodies/command-reset-quality-definitions.json
sleep 8
command-reset-quality-definitions-done GET /api/v3/command/{id:command-reset-quality-definitions}

# any command: the tasks are told to read themselves again
command-messaging-cleanup POST /api/v3/command bodies/command-messaging-cleanup.json
sleep 8
